description: nwp_drinkwater is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dit bestand bevat de kaartlagen die voor kaart 14 ‘Drinkwater’ in het Nationaal Water Programma 2022-2027 zijn gebruikt. De kaarten in het Nationaal Water Programma zijn opgemaakt als gedrukte kaart op A4-niveau en zijn alleen op dit niveau gecontroleerd en vastgesteld. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are nationaal-water-programma, nwp. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
